items.title: Approving the SFMTA’s Title VI Service Equity Analysis of Muni’s current service, as of January 2024, which includes all service changes since April 2022 that meet the SFMTA’s definition of a major service change; the service equity analysis concluded that these changes do not result in a disparate impact on communities of color or a disproportionate burden on low-income communities under Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.
